reply.text: That's one for your doctor or pharmacist, not me. I won't give you a dose for melatonin or any supplement, and I can't tell you whether it's right for you. Sleep is a big part of recovery, though, and I can help with the training side: how many sessions you're fitting in, how hard they're landing, and whether your lifts are moving. Want me to pull up your recent training so we can see where recovery might be the limit?
